# TC.PeripheralDetach

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.PeripheralDetach"></a>

### TC.PeripheralDetach

This event reports physical detachment.
Before delivery, the host revokes authority and cleans still-owned outputs,
even without a registered guest handler.

Extends: TC.BaseEvent

### name

Detachment discriminator.

```text
'peripheral_detach'
```

### peripheral

Detached identity. Old handles do not retarget.

```text
TC.PeripheralName
```

### peripheral_type

Prior public peripheral family name.

```text
string
```

### reason

Physical transition reason.

```text
'wire_removed'|'removed'|'regrouped'|'force_changed'|'surface_changed'|'limit'|'unavailable'
```

### wire

Channel that lost authority.

```text
TC.Wire
```
